result:
Summary: CrewAI is highlighted as the fastest framework for setting up multi-agent flows, taking around 10 minutes from installation to first flow with role-based scaffolding. It is noted for its ease of use and quick deployment, making it suitable for fast validation of agent value before investing in more complex infrastructure. LangGraph, on the other hand, is described as the deepest production framework with graph-based control flow and extensive observability, but it requires more time and effort to define the graph structure explicitly, taking around 45 minutes for the same flow. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on the orchestration overhead of ACE with LangGraph CrewAI.
